newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Delifrance Asia gets nod for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: Delifrance Asia gets nod for Singapore listing.

text.p: Retailer and wholesaler of French pastries Delifrance Asia Ltd said on Wednesday it had received approval in principle for a listing on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
The company did not say when it would be listed but in Singapore listing is usually within one to two months of approval.
The group operates more than 120 retail outlets and five factories in Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, China, Philippines, Australia and Brunei.
It planned to explore new markets and expand its network of manufacturing and retail operations in Asia through owner-operators, joint ventures and franchising, it said in a statement.
The group recorded a pretax profit of Singapore $9.2 million on a turnover of Singapore $98.5 million for the year ended June 30, 1996. -- Singapore newsroom (65-8703080)
